exactArithmetic: Compiled inputs have at most 64 points, 1024 arcs and |weight| <= 1,000,000. Each candidate path sums at most 64 * 1024 weights. Relaxation and origin shifts are exact binary64 integers; exposed values are converted to Int64.
method: Pinned release JS. Independent same-binary control and two paired process orders per candidate. Ordinary: three process pairs, each with three warmups and nine 500-call samples. Deep: four process pairs, each with three warmups and nine 16-call samples. CLI: two warmup pairs and nine measured pairs per case, with RSS and startup included. Negative percentages mean lower latency.

profile.method: Counters and timing wrappers run in separate processes. Counts include warmups and budget probes. Timings include wrapper overhead.
